Variants.Content: Azor Ahai is an ancient savior legend across the Narrow Sea, often associated with the Long Night, Light, and the Reforged Sword. The believers of the Red God look for future salvation in it, and the maester regards it as evidence of the mutual influence of myths; the reason why legends are powerful is that every time of crisis Generations want to recognize their heroes.
